agents.drug_class_hint: investigational bitopic DRD2 antagonist / ClpP agonist (imipridone)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: DRD2 antagonist / ClpP agonist causing a stress response in tumour cells

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult phase 1 in DMG H3K27-altered (Arms A-C) and other recurrent primary malignant CNS tumours (Arm D); glioblastoma only in conditions list. Regimen is mixed across arms (A, D ONC206 alone; B, C ONC206 + radiotherapy); coded combination because radiotherapy is in some experimental arms. H3K27 alteration is not mechanistically linked to ONC206 (DRD2/ClpP), so not candidate-matched.
